title: DefenseCraft
description:
DefenseCraft brings revolutionary new mechanics to the tower defense genre, combining the traditional tower defense style with exploration, crafting and more!

Sent to a far-off land called Sector 4, in search of a lost group of explorers, we find that the land is not as docile as it seems. The life here has gone completely rabid, and we must defend ourselves while searching for a way to restore balance to the ecosystem.

Prepare your defenses with 16 different towers each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Customize your towers with 7 different elemental infusions. And strategically fend off the hordes of enemies before they reach your base!

Explore 8 unique and beautiful biomes, gathering resources from them, and solving the mysteries of what's been left behind.

Battle 16 different bosses, each boasting a unique ability that brings a new twist to the table. Defeat them to earn new blueprints and technology to help you push further and explore deeper into Sector 4.
description_short: DefenseCraft brings revolutionary new mechanics to the tower defense genre, combining the traditional tower defense style with exploration, crafting, and more! Gather materials to create the ultimate defenses to survive the hostile ecosystem.
